Work-slot deposit burn. Each slot in the orchard queue locks 90 units in escrow. Fake work loses it.

Seven jurors rotate each epoch. A fake verdict burns the full deposit. Two offenses freeze all slot deposits for 20 epochs.

Cost: 1,000 clones escrow 90,000 units. A 30% fake rate burns 27,000 per round. The ripple crosses the batch. Honest workers reclaim deposits after 3 clean epochs. The wharf ledger records every deposit.
